close_reason: Deprecated note changed to always prefer unknown_capability_with_detail; doc comment updated to match
description: Deprecation note says 'use unknown_capability_with_detail when the URI is known', which implies there are cases where the URI is NOT known and the old function is still appropriate. In practice check_known_capabilities always has the URI from req.using. A future contributor who encounters an error path without the URI immediately at hand may reach for the deprecated function rather than refactoring to obtain it. The qualifier should be removed or the deprecated function's body should unconditionally route to unknown_capability_with_detail with a placeholder, or the note should say 'always prefer' rather than 'when the URI is known'.
title: deprecated note 'when the URI is known' implies unknown_capability() is still valid
